items.title: China-Backed Hackers Are Industrializing Botnets
items.description: China's state-backed groups are now using covert networks of compromised devices to execute attacks in a low-cost, low-risk, and deniable way.

items.title: ZDI-CAN-30459: Flowise
items.description: A CVSS score 9.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Dre Cura (@dre_cura) of TrendAI Research' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2026-04-23, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-08-21 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
